name: ProverBench
intro: ProverBench是DeepSeek-Prover-V2论文提出的Lean 4形式化定理证明基准，共325题。15题从AIME 2024与2025的数论和代数题中筛选，明确排除几何、组合与计数题；另310题来自精选教材和教育教程，覆盖九个非AIME数学领域。
build_method: 筛选15道AIME 2024-2025数论与代数题，并从教材和教育教程精选、形式化310道竞赛与本科数学题
eval_feature: non-CoT直接补全Lean 4代码，CoT先给详细证明计划再生成最终证明；使用32/128/512样本预算并在Lean 4.9.0-rc2中形式验证
build_method_en: Select and formalize 15 number-theory and algebra problems from AIME 2024-2025, then curate and formalize 310 competition and undergraduate problems from textbooks and educational tutorials
eval_feature_en: Non-CoT directly completes Lean 4 code, while CoT first supplies a detailed proof plan and then the final proof; candidate budgets are 32, 128, and 512 with formal verification in Lean 4.9.0-rc2
intro_en: ProverBench is a 325-problem Lean 4 formal theorem-proving benchmark introduced with DeepSeek-Prover-V2. Fifteen number-theory and algebra problems are selected from AIME 2024-2025 after excluding geometry, combinatorics, and counting. Another 310 problems come from curated textbooks and educational tutorials across nine non-AIME mathematical areas.
scale_en: 325 problems: 15 from AIME 2024-2025 and 310 from textbooks or tutorials; the nine non-AIME area counts are 40/30/50/40/90/30/10/10/10

drawio_review_note: reviewed_at=2026-07-18; source_stage=paper-and-official-release alignment; scope=ProverBench benchmark construction and evaluation only. The primary paper is pinned to https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.21801v2 and https://arxiv.org/pdf/2504.21801v2. The reviewed PDF SHA256 is b201eb048acc409a0331d6982da385f305660c7bd73cfb843414c22951355131. The official model repository is pinned to https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Prover-V2/tree/e598a57ea3284997d4a2a168a069fdd5064afbc8; README.md SHA256 at that commit is 08d0b515c693c84d2aca9160efe72e15405f85d8990c547f7a779a555753fb54 and LICENSE-MODEL SHA256 is ccfee4895df06bcab524151c278e8dde88bbe76165a24ecbcbcf9fafd71fd2b3. The official dataset is pinned to https://huggingface.co/datasets/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-ProverBench/tree/3b9f067088e5e005fab91434ddc05a903e0a6252; README.md SHA256 is 9b401b7ddeba804aa7595c4a4bc44ebc3b5865e8f76ac47b3938a30624ed1e21 and proverbench.jsonl SHA256 is 37974883580aa0f4ab053b3e4748170eb90c3bd439e9acdbece4fd896338e1f7. The paper construction has two source branches. The AIME branch starts from AIME 2024 and 2025 number-theory and algebra questions and filters out geometry, combinatorics, and counting because their Lean representations may be cumbersome. It retains and formalizes 15 problems. The second branch carefully selects textbook examples and educational tutorials used for high-school competitions and undergraduate courses and formalizes 310 additional problems. The nine non-AIME fields and exact counts are Number Theory 40, Elementary Algebra 30, Linear Algebra 50, Abstract Algebra 40, Calculus 90, Real Analysis 30, Complex Analysis 10, Functional Analysis 10, and Probability 10. Together with the 15 AIME items they form exactly 325 problems. The pinned HF JSONL has 325 rows and exactly the fields header, formal_statement, name, and area. Its area counts reproduce the paper distribution plus an aime area of 15. Evaluation is benchmark-only. The non-CoT prompt asks the model to complete the supplied Lean 4 code directly. The CoT prompt first requests a detailed proof plan with main steps, strategies, intermediate lemmas, and proof structures, then asks for the final Lean 4 proof. The paper evaluates in Lean 4.9.0-rc2 and Table 7 uses sample budgets 32, 128, and 512. For DeepSeek-Prover-V2 non-CoT 7B, All pass ratios are 47.7, 48.8, and 49.5 percent and AIME solved counts are 1, 1, and 1. For non-CoT 671B they are 49.5, 51.5, and 52.3 percent with AIME 1, 2, and 2. For CoT 7B they are 49.0, 50.8, and 51.7 percent with AIME 1, 1, and 1. For CoT 671B they are 52.9, 56.5, and 59.1 percent with AIME 4, 5, and 6. All denotes the complete 325-problem set and AIME denotes the 15-problem subset. Cold-start synthesis and reinforcement learning are model training, not benchmark construction, and remain outside the solid build path. They are mentioned only in a dashed boundary card so the benchmark figure does not reproduce the DeepSeek-Prover-V2 training pipeline. Release boundaries are explicit. A standalone dataset license and standalone evaluation harness are not disclosed by the pinned dataset card or repository. The repository's model-license section governs the DeepSeek-Prover-V2 models and does not establish a standalone license for the ProverBench dataset. The pinned repository does not ship an identified end-to-end ProverBench evaluation runner, so no executable harness, parser, retry policy, or result materialization is invented. Solid arrows show only AIME filtering, textbook and tutorial curation, formalization, the 325-item merge, prompt modes, budgets, Lean verification, and Table 7 reporting. Dashed arrows show fixed source and HF evidence, training separation, missing standalone harness, and missing dataset-license boundaries. English and Chinese specs have identical semantic node IDs, types, positions, node styles, edge types, edge styles, waypoints, and modules. Every secondary edge sets dashed=true and no edge has a label. Source-stage fallback fields remain null or empty. Formal Draw.io, architecture JSON, SVG, PNG, catalog, manifest, and synchronization files are intentionally unchanged in this source-stage handoff.
